component.name: Moonfin
component.summary: Media client for self hosted media servers

description.p: Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Silo servers, built with Flutter. It's made for people who want a modern, customizable experience on every screen they own. Key features include customizable UI styles and themes on every screen, offline downloads, ebook support, retro game support, multi-server unified libraries, an integrated admin panel, seerr integration, settings sync, live tv and dvr, and so much more!

ul.li: Plex Support added in addition to Jellyfin and Emby
Desktop Mini Player
Browse episodes without leaving the player
Revamped playback info panel
Dual subtitle support, and enhanced subtitle controls without leaving the player
Live TV recording enhancements, including a record button in the player, series/incomplete recordings markings, and external player support
Media bar enhancements, including external content support, separate ratings from the home screen, and peek home rows
A refined home screen, with a redesigned classic info area, trailer preview, external rows sorting, a redesigned home row editor, and new card sizes
Five new seasonal effects, with custom focus effects that follow your cursor for some of them
New video library styles for added customization
Completely redesigned book and music library screens with 3 style options tailored to their content types instead of matching video libraries
A brand new epub reader based on epub.js
Comics/PDFs/Books now sync progress with the server
User reviews on item details screens
A trailer picker to browse multiple trailers for an item instead of only the default one
Streaming services links on seerr pages
Social media links on person pages
Smart downloads to follow your watch status
Skip intro/credits works offline
Support for seerr discover sliders
Link your RomM account for retro games
Redesigned game details screen
Native touch controls for each game system
Redesigned add server screen to showcase the many ways to sign in
Sign in pins from the server
Reorganized settings to make it easier to find what you want to change
Redesigned admin panel with updated screens, search, and more settings access than ever before
Support for HEVC copy to reduce transcode burden when only the audio needs transocding
Transcoded downloads keep the audio track you picked
Forced and flagged subtitle modes skip forced tracks in languages you don't read
Older language codes match their modern ones
Subtitle backgrounds draw a box instead of a shadow
Trailer captions follow the trailer captions setting instead of falling back to Youtube's default
Emby Live TV plays
Cancelling a recording from schedule works
Sonarr calendar shows evening episodes on the correct day for your timezone
Video playback is now supported on X11 instead of being wayland only
Fixed mpv's dithering to eliminate banding in dark gradients
Controllers work on desktop as well as TV
Home no longer lags with large collections
Empty home sections no longer flash
Modern focus cards animation was smoothed out on fast scrolling
Per row image type syncs with Moonbase
Left sidebar no longer pops out when loading new screens, and arrow keys navigate it on desktop
Playing a collection follows its order
Extras are in order
Renaming a playlist no longer crashes
Comics with '#' in the name no longer fail to download
A seerr page switches to a standard library page automatically once the title is available
Playstation cue/bin games load
